defmodule ProxyUpload.Router do
  use Plug.Router
  import Plug.Conn

  plug :match
  plug :dispatch

  @upload_dir "/tmp/proxy_uploads"
  @max_file_size 10_485_760

  defmodule TokenStore do
    use Agent

    def start_link(_opts) do
      Agent.start_link(fn -> %{} end, name: __MODULE__)
    end

    def generate_token(session_id) do
      token = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32) |> Base.url_encode64(padding: false)
      Agent.update(__MODULE__, fn state ->
        Map.put(state, session_id, %{token: token, issued_at: System.monotonic_time(:second)})
      end)
      token
    end

    def validate_token(session_id, token) do
      Agent.get(__MODULE__, fn state ->
        case Map.get(state, session_id) do
          %{token: stored_token, issued_at: issued_at} ->
            now = System.monotonic_time(:second)
            time_valid = now - issued_at < 3600
            token_match = compare_tokens(stored_token, token)
            time_valid and token_match
          nil -> false
        end
      end)
    end

    defp compare_tokens(stored, provided) do
      if byte_size(stored) == byte_size(provided) do
        stored == provided
      else
        false
      end
    end
  end

  defmodule SessionManager do
    def get_session_id(conn) do
      case get_req_header(conn, "x-session-id") do
        [session_id | _] -> {:ok, session_id}
        [] ->
          case conn.cookies["_proxy_session"] do
            nil -> {:error, :no_session}
            sid -> {:ok, sid}
          end
      end
    end

    def authenticated?(conn) do
      case get_session_id(conn) do
        {:ok, _sid} -> true
        _ -> false
      end
    end
  end

  defmodule CSRFProtection do
    def verify_csrf(conn, session_id) do
      request_token = extract_token(conn)
      case request_token do
        nil -> {:error, :missing_token}
        token -> 
          if TokenStore.validate_token(session_id, token) do
            {:ok, :valid}
          else
            {:error, :invalid_token}
          end
      end
    end

    defp extract_token(conn) do
      # Check header first, then form body
      case get_req_header(conn, "x-csrf-token") do
        [token | _] -> token
        [] ->
          case conn.body_params do
            %{"_csrf_token" => token} -> token
            _ -> nil
          end
      end
    end

    defp get_req_header(conn, header) do
      Plug.Conn.get_req_header(conn, header)
    end
  end

  defmodule UploadHandler do
    def process_upload(conn, session_id) do
      with {:ok, file_params} <- extract_file(conn),
           :ok <- validate_file_size(file_params),
           :ok <- validate_content_type(file_params),
           {:ok, dest_path} <- store_file(file_params, session_id) do
        {:ok, dest_path}
      end
    end

    defp extract_file(conn) do
      case conn.body_params do
        %{"file" => %Plug.Upload{} = upload} -> {:ok, upload}
        _ -> {:error, :no_file}
      end
    end

    defp validate_file_size(%Plug.Upload{path: path}) do
      case File.stat(path) do
        {:ok, %{size: size}} when size <= @max_file_size -> :ok
        {:ok, _} -> {:error, :file_too_large}
        {:error, _} -> {:error, :stat_failed}
      end
    end

    defp validate_content_type(%Plug.Upload{content_type: ct}) do
      allowed = ["image/png", "image/jpeg", "application/pdf", "text/plain"]
      if ct in allowed, do: :ok, else: {:error, :invalid_content_type}
    end

    defp store_file(%Plug.Upload{path: src, filename: fname}, session_id) do
      safe_name = sanitize_filename(fname)
      dest_dir = Path.join(@upload_dir, session_id)
      File.mkdir_p!(dest_dir)
      dest = Path.join(dest_dir, safe_name)
      case File.cp(src, dest) do
        :ok -> {:ok, dest}
        {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
      end
    end

    defp sanitize_filename(name) do
      name
      |> Path.basename()
      |> String.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, "_")
    end
  end

  # Routes
  get "/csrf-token" do
    case SessionManager.get_session_id(conn) do
      {:ok, session_id} ->
        token = TokenStore.generate_token(session_id)
        conn
        |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
        |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{csrf_token: token}))
      {:error, _} ->
        send_resp(conn, 401, "Unauthorized")
    end
  end

  post "/upload" do
    with {:ok, session_id} <- SessionManager.get_session_id(conn),
         true <- SessionManager.authenticated?(conn),
         {:ok, :valid} <- verify_upload_csrf(conn, session_id),
         {:ok, path} <- UploadHandler.process_upload(conn, session_id) do
      conn
      |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
      |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "uploaded", path: path}))
    else
      {:error, :missing_token} -> send_resp(conn, 403, "CSRF token required")
      {:error, :invalid_token} -> send_resp(conn, 403, "Invalid CSRF token")
      {:error, reason} -> send_resp(conn, 400, "Upload failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
      false -> send_resp(conn, 401, "Not authenticated")
    end
  end

  post "/proxy-forward" do
    with {:ok, session_id} <- SessionManager.get_session_id(conn),
         true <- SessionManager.authenticated?(conn) do
      # Proxy forwarding for uploaded content - internal API
      target = conn.body_params["target_url"]
      file_ref = conn.body_params["file_ref"]
      forward_upload(conn, session_id, target, file_ref)
    else
      _ -> send_resp(conn, 401, "Unauthorized")
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "Not found")
  end

  # The CSRF check for uploads uses a different verification path
  # that checks the Origin header as a secondary validation
  defp verify_upload_csrf(conn, session_id) do
    origin = get_req_header(conn, "origin") |> List.first()
    referer = get_req_header(conn, "referer") |> List.first()

    # If request comes from same origin, relax CSRF for proxy-initiated uploads
    if is_proxy_origin?(origin) or is_proxy_origin?(referer) do
      {:ok, :valid}
    else
      CSRFProtection.verify_csrf(conn, session_id)
    end
  end

  defp is_proxy_origin?(nil), do: false
  defp is_proxy_origin?(value) do
    uri = URI.parse(value)
    uri.host in ["localhost", "127.0.0.1", "proxy.internal"] and
      uri.scheme in ["http", "https"]
  end

  defp forward_upload(conn, session_id, target, file_ref) when is_binary(target) and is_binary(file_ref) do
    file_path = Path.join([@upload_dir, session_id, Path.basename(file_ref)])
    if File.exists?(file_path) do
      # Forward to internal service
      conn
      |> put_resp_content_type("application/json")
      |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{forwarded: true, target: target}))
    else
      send_resp(conn, 404, "File not found")
    end
  end

  defp forward_upload(conn, _session_id, _target, _file_ref) do
    send_resp(conn, 400, "Invalid parameters")
  end
end
